title: LibraryLinks
description: Public list of the student documents cited by link (library/links.json): documents of library/README.md « Documents cités par lien », consulted at the publisher's address, never copied in library/. Sorted by title (case and accents ignored). Bibliographic fields only: no other property is allowed.

reference.description: Document number or part number as printed by the publisher.

revision.description: Revision label as printed by the publisher.

date.description: Publication date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD); null when not recorded.

primary_url.description: Publisher's address, opened by the application.
